sentences.text:
Mr. A.K. Nirankari - Public Prosecutor for the responden
Heard on I.A. No.26296/2024, an application for interim suspension of sentence filed on behalf of
appellant - Balveer on the ground of death of his father.

2.  The appellant has been convicted and sentenced by impugned judgment dated 25.05.2024 as under:-
 Section Imprisonment Fine  376(3) of IPC 20 years 5,000/-, with defaul  5(i)(ii) of POCSO Act 20 years 5,000/-, with defaul  315 of IPC 05 years 1,000/-, with defaul  313 of IPC 05 years 1,000/-, with defaul  506 part-II of IPC 02 years 5,00/- with default  3.

It is the submission of counsel for the appellant that father of the appellant has passed away on 08.12.2024 and his 13th day ceremony (terhavi) is going to be held on 21.12.2024, therefore, he is seeking temporary suspension so that he can attend the last rites & rituals of his father.

4. Counsel for the State on the basis of telephonic instructions received from Polie Station Isagarh,
District Ashoknagar verified the fact of death of father of the appellant.
Considering the aforesaid submission and reason, the appellant deserves to be released on temporary bail.
Accordingly, I.A.No.26296/2024 for temporary suspension of sentence of appellant -Balveer is allowed.

Appellant is directed to be released on temporary suspension from 14.12.2024 till 24.12.2024 subject to furnishing a personal bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Balveer vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140142993/
1 Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.
6 . Appellant shall surrender immediately on or before 24.12.2024 before the concerned trial Court for serving the remaining jail sentence.
7. It is made clear that during the release of the appellant, he shall not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant side in any manner and shall not cause any trouble to them.

8. List the case thereafter along with surrender report.
9.

(ANAND PATHAK) (ROOPESH CHANDRA VAR  JUDGE JUDGE  bj/-
